purpose: Teach: フェミニスト/思慮/恒常/親日/親睦/大局/同紙/領主

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、フェミニスト視点での医療を医療チームで意識します
lines.en: Ren, we make sure our medical team stays conscious of feminist perspectives in healthcare.
lines.style: Clear and direct, with a steady clinical tone. Even pacing, measured delivery. No performance—just professional clarity. Eyes level.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、患者への思慮ある説明を医療チームで心がけます
lines.en: Yes, and our team takes care to explain things to patients with real consideration.
lines.style: Warm but measured. The reassurance of someone who has said this many times and means it each time. Slight emphasis on 'care,' not lecturing.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、生体の恒常性維持を医療チームで研究します
lines.en: Ren, maintaining the body's homeostasis—that's something we study as a team.
lines.style: Calm, methodical. The voice of someone explaining fundamental principle. Even tone, no rush. Slightly lower energy than before, settling into the idea.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 親日的な外国人患者を、貴院、丁寧に診られますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital really does examine foreign patients with such care and consideration, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Genuine observation, not quite a question. Soft admiration underneath. Slight hesitation before speaking, like he's choosing his words carefully. Respectful but not deferential.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、医療従事者の親睦会を医療チームで開きます
lines.en: Yes, we hold regular fellowship meetings for our medical staff to strengthen those connections.
lines.style: Direct response, professional tone. Confident without being dismissive of what Ren said. Slight nod embedded in the voice—acknowledgment of the observation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療の大局を、貴院、見据えてらっしゃいますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital really does take the broader view of medicine, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Softer this time, more wondering. The second part of a realization dawning. Quiet respect in the pacing. Not challenging—genuinely impressed, and a little uncertain how to say it.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、同紙報道の医療事故事例を医療チームで参考にします
lines.en: Yes, we reference case studies of medical incidents from the same publications to learn from them as a team.
lines.style: Steady, clinical. This is practical learning. No shame in it—just competence. Slightly faster pace than before, matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、中世領主時代の医療史も医療チームで研究します
lines.en: Yes, we even study the history of medicine—including medieval medical practice—as part of our team's research.
lines.style: Quieter, almost reflective now. The smallest hint of a smile in the voice—slight warmth at the breadth of the inquiry. Trailing off very gently at the end, satisfied. Breathing space between clauses.
